'''''X-Ray-two-niner-one''''' was the designation of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln starfighter]] assigned to [[Trid]].

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] it was assigned to orbital patrol over [[Danuta]] with his wing. When ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' approached, the two TIEs flanked it and the X-Ray pilot requested identity and business, his monotonous voice suggesting he had repeated the request countless of times. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] pilot introduced himself as "[[Kyle Katarn|Dan Drexel]]" and said that he was coming from [[Drog VI]] bringing spares for [[Brodsport Mining Corporation]]; he added that the [[TIE pilot]] should tell [[Rel Farley]] that he will buy the first round of [[beer]]s once he lands. After some time, presumably checking with Brodsport or Farley (or just keeping some silence to give the impression he was doing so), X-Ray gave clearance and sent approach vectors for the [[Trid spaceport]] to the freighter, with a stern warning to stay within them.<ref name="sfte">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref><ref name="AD">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>

A couple of local days later, the customs agent notified the authorities that the "Drexel" character who came on that ship was defector [[Kyle Katarn]], who had become a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]; right that time his accomplice, [[Jan Ors]], was taking the ''Crow'' to meet him at the [[Danuta research facility]]. It fired at the guards and the parked TIEs for an unauthorised lift-off when X-Ray showed up. The pilot ordered the ''Crow'' to reverse and power down, shooting at it and diminishing the freighter's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. He boasted that the TIE can make circles around the junk, but Ors used its belly cannon, and shot down the TIE.<ref name="AD" />
